# @dxtmisha/test

> Modular Vue 3 UI testing and documentation harness library.

Provides dedicated test containers (`DxtTestPage`, `DxtTestBlock`, `DxtTestButton`), interactive AI/Storybook wiki documentation components (`DxtTestWiki`, `DxtTestWikiPropItem`, `DxtTestWikiDemo`, `DxtTestWikiAnchor`, `DxtTestWikiHide`), and shared state composables (`useWikiItemFocus`, `useWikiPropsHide`) for testing and documenting DXT UI components.

## Key Components & Modules

- [DxtTestPage](src/components/DxtTestPage.vue): Root layout wrapper for component test and AI wiki suites.
- [DxtTestBlock](src/components/DxtTestBlock.vue): Isolated scenario container with title, description, and anchor support for rendering individual component states.
- [DxtTestButton](src/components/DxtTestButton.vue): Compact control button with `selected` state support for test harness actions.
- [DxtTestWiki](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWiki.vue): Main AI wiki documentation block rendering component demos, descriptions, type headers (`Props`, `Emits`, `Slots`, `Expose`), and filtered property items; respects `useWikiItemFocus` and `useWikiPropsHide` (`getAiHide()` / `isHide()`).
- [DxtTestWikiPropItem](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiPropItem.vue): Property item renderer displaying prop name, type, description, default value, and compact interactive option demos; conditionally rendered via `v-if` based on `useWikiPropsHide`.
- [DxtTestWikiDemo](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiDemo.vue): Live component preview and formatted JSX/template code snippet generator with `compact` inline mode support.
- [DxtTestWikiAnchor](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiAnchor.vue): Multi-column navigation index for focusing on a specific component or showing all components (`useWikiItemFocus`).
- [DxtTestWikiHide](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiHide.vue): Toggle button (`useWikiPropsHide`) for hiding/showing obvious properties and AI-hidden components in the DOM.
- [DxtTestWikiTitle](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiTitle.vue): Section header component displaying section labels and TypeScript interface/type names.
- [DxtTestWikiCode](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiCode.vue): Styled `<pre>` block for displaying inline or block code snippets.
- [DxtTestWikiPossibilities](src/components/Wiki/DxtTestWikiPossibilities.vue): Bulleted list renderer for component capabilities.
- [useWikiItemFocus](src/composables/useWikiItemFocus.ts): Session-backed composable (`useSessionRef`) managing active component focus (`'all'` or component name).
- [useWikiPropsHide](src/composables/useWikiPropsHide.ts): Session-backed composable (`useSessionRef`) managing visibility of hidden properties and AI-hidden components.
- [wikiTypes.ts](src/types/wikiTypes.ts): TypeScript interfaces for custom demo slot rendering (`TestWikiDemoClasses`, `TestWikiSlotRender`).
- [library.ts](src/library.ts): Main entry point exporting all composables, types, and Vue test harness components.

## Exports

- `@dxtmisha/test` (`.`): Vue components, composables (`useWikiItemFocus`, `useWikiPropsHide`), and types.
- `@dxtmisha/test/style.css`: Compiled component styles.
